description: List the user's posting queue — scheduled and published LinkedIn posts, grouped by date. Optionally filter by status. Each entry includes its schedule id (use it to cancel/reschedule). Requires a paid Creator/Lifetime plan.

status.description: Filter the queue by status. If the user didn't name a status, prefer 'none' (or omit) — 'none' returns the whole queue.

name: get_queue
